text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B and Stock C after gains because realizing profits feels good; I should base sales on my portfolio plan, not the comfort of locking in a gain.","A stock’s average cost and past price changes do not tell me what it will do next, so I should avoid both clinging to a losing position and treating a winner as destined to fall.","I rarely trade and prices are unpredictable, so I should check that my holdings remain diversified and make deliberate decisions rather than reacting to short-term account changes."]}
